reviews.title: Disappointed with this app.
reviews.text:
I’m very disappointed with this app.

I discovered it through an Instagram ad that specifically demonstrated the ability to add a beautiful sunset light effect to any photo. This was the main and only reason I decided to download the app.

Unfortunately, there was no free trial available, so I had to pay for the subscription immediately. After subscribing, I discovered that the sunset light effect shown in the advertisement was not actually available in the app.

I do not need any of the other features, so the subscription is completely useless to me. This feels very misleading and extremely disappointing.

I have also contacted customer support, but I have received no response.

I would like to request a full refund for my subscription.

reviews.title: SCAM - Forced to pay £4.99 for weekly use, then also charged £29.99 on top for a free month trial
reviews.text:
The app asked me to pay an upfront subscription fee to get into the app. After accepting £4.99 for a weekly subscription, I was then prompted by the app to accept a free month trial, which I then found from my bank account, I have been charged £29.99 for the month (so not free), on top of the £4.99 weekly charge.
I tried to use the app to edit some photos, but a message appeared stating that the charge per photo is also £4.99.
So the subscription is just for the privilege of downloading the app, which doesn’t really do a anything. An ordinary iPhone or photoshop would be far more convenient and less expensive.

AVOID THIS APP!!!

In response to the developer reply;

“We’re sorry to hear about your experience. Subscription options and pricing are displayed by the App Store before any purchase is confirmed. We would also like to clarify that we do not offer a free one-month trial, so there may have been some misunderstanding regarding the charge. All financial transactions, charges, refunds, and billing decisions are handled directly by Apple between the App Store and the user. We do not have the ability to process payments or issue charges ourselves. Please contact us through the in-app support chat and we’ll be happy to help investigate what happened. 💛"
